notes:
V3.1.4 — credits-based pricing for the MAKE BOT 'Via APEX' provider.

Server:
• POST /api/makebot/generate now charges 10 credits per successful generation. Pre-flight balance check returns 402 with a clear message when the user can't afford it.
• New GET /api/makebot/price returns the current cost + the caller's balance so the desktop can render an accurate label without guessing.
• New signups (email/password OR Google) get a 100-credit welcome bonus → 10 free generations to try MAKE BOT.
• Both Anthropic-pool and user-fallback paths charge credits — the 'Via APEX' label means 'goes through the APEX pricing model', regardless of which key the server uses to actually call Anthropic.

Desktop:
• Provider dropdown relabelled: 'Via APEX (uses your APEX credits)' instead of 'Free (via APEX, no key)' so the name matches reality.
• Gradient badge next to the dropdown now shows '◊ 10 / gen · balance: N' with a live balance fetched on selection and refreshed after every successful generation.
• Insufficient-credits errors land as a clean message from the server, no Python tracebacks.
• Generic API-error formatter now handles FastAPI's {detail: …} response shape — error messages from the APEX server are no longer gibberish.

Note on 'free consumer Claude / ChatGPT accounts': not technically feasible (no public API, and scraping the consumer UI violates ToS). Use OpenRouter ':free' models or Google Gemini's free API tier if you genuinely want zero-cost — both are already provider options or trivially addable.
